南洋廳統計年鑑 1936

Nan'yōchō tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the South Seas Government), 第六回 (No. 6), figures mainly for 昭和7–11 (1932–1936), published 昭和13年3月 (March 1938)
南洋廳長官官房調査課, パラオ (昭和十三年)

All 220 numbered tables are transcribed, with the appendix table of weights and measures (度量衡比較表); the contents, the maps, the statistical charts (統計圖表), the prose survey (概說) and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Figures are kept exactly as printed, including points or spaces printed where a comma or decimal point is expected. Small figures printed above a cell (foreigners, half-year taxpayers, quantities) are given in the same cell after the figure; in the trade tables many of these small quantities are too blurred to read and are marked [?]. The volume's errata slip (正誤表, 45 corrections) is attached as a note to each table it concerns; the figures stay as printed. About 380 of some 82,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?.
